questions.q_en: Who authored "Tuzuk-i-Jahangiri"?
questions.solution_en:
• Tuzuk-i-Jahangiri, or "The Memoirs of Jahangir," is the autobiography of Mughal Emperor Jahangir, offering insights into his life, thoughts, and the Mughal court.

• Akbar did not write an autobiography, but "Ain-i-Akbari" and "Akbarnama" were written by Abul Fazl to chronicle his reign.

• Babur authored "Baburnama," which is considered the first true autobiography in Islamic literature.
